_about: D1a reads only which meters this fighter has (Fighter.hasAnguish, hasMenace: the data-driven meters of Game Design's ruling). The numbers document today's rules in sim/core/fighter.gd, damage.gd and sim/world/collateral.gd and are wired in D1b (docs/architecture/d1-roster-data.md section 5); until then editing them changes nothing but the data hash. Casualty amounts are per person, normalised by 425 / pop0. Event names are D1b placeholders.
